item.description:
Symphonia 1.0.4 records network reconnects in the activity log.

  • Reconnects are logged. When players stop hearing from Symphonia and it reconnects, the activity log now says so, and it notes when players can find the server again. This makes it easier to see what happened if a player loses track of Symphonia.

Also new since 1.0:

  • A warning when players can't find Symphonia (1.0.1). Right after an install or update, macOS can briefly block Symphonia's access to your network. The status page now shows a warning when that happens.
  • Reconnects by itself (1.0.2, 1.0.3). Symphonia keeps serving music and reconnects on its own, usually within a few minutes, with no need to choose Try Again.
  • If the warning stays for more than 10 minutes, quit and reopen Symphonia. If that doesn't help, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network, turn Symphonia off and on again, then quit and reopen Symphonia.
